The '''Lomabu system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] which contained [[Lomabu III]] and five other [[Planet/Legends|planets]] in erratic [[Orbit/Legends|orbits]] around the orange primary [[Star/Legends|star]].
